role: Provider Partnerships Leader (backed by Y Combinator, $5M+ ARR, $20M+ raised)

hero.label: Made for Legion Health
hero.headline: I want to help Legion Health bring autonomous care to every patient.
hero.subheadline: Legion Health is doing something I genuinely believe in: using AI to make high-quality psychiatric care accessible without the bottlenecks of traditional systems. The Provider Partnerships role sits at the exact intersection of outreach, relationship-building, and mission-driven growth that I have been working toward. I want to be on the ground floor of scaling something that actually changes how people get help.

whyCompany.title: Autonomous care is the infrastructure mental health has always needed
whyCompany.body: Most mental health startups digitize the existing broken model. Legion Health is rethinking the care delivery layer itself, which means provider partnerships are not just a sales function but a structural piece of the product. Getting that network right at this stage determines what the company can become at scale.

whyCompany.title: Y Combinator backing and $5M+ ARR means the model is proven and timing is now
whyCompany.body: Legion Health has cleared the hardest early hurdle: real revenue from real customers. With $20M+ raised, the next phase is aggressive expansion, and that is exactly when a hungry partnerships hire can have outsized impact. I want to be the person who helps build that provider network before it becomes a known brand everyone is chasing.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and digital marketing background maps directly to this role
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach end to end, built LinkedIn sequences, managed HubSpot pipelines, and helped close 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch. At NextAfter I learned how mission-driven organizations think about growth and relationships in a B2B context. Provider partnerships requires exactly that combination: structured outreach discipline and the ability to communicate genuine value to people who care about outcomes, not just features.

quote: I have spent the last year learning how to find the right people, earn their attention, and show them something worth believing in. Legion Health is the first company where I want to do that work and feel like the mission is doing half the job for me.
